summary.text: Howard Penny Jr. is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 53 since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists him as House Deputy Majority Whip and describes his occupation as retired agribusiness.

paragraphs.text: Howard Penny Jr. served on the Harnett County Schools board, District 3, from 2014 to 2016, according to Ballotpedia.

In August 2020 the Harnett County Republican Party Executive Committee selected Penny to replace retiring incumbent David Lewis Sr. on the November ballot, and Penny assumed office on September 17, 2020.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as deacon and Sunday school teacher and his religion as Baptist.
The General Assembly lists Harnett and Johnston counties for District 53.
The Republican primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
